subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Acme MAP draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & MAP draft (next steps)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) attached. High-level notes: 

- Pain points: slow inference latency on peak loads (~800ms p50 currently), cost per 1k tokens is higher than expected due to redundant small-batch calls, lack of observability into per-route token spend.
- Goals: 50% reduction in per-token cost for gen routes, target p95 latency <= 250ms for customer-facing chat flows, consistent rollout path for model updates with canary testing.
- Stakeholders: Alice (product), Tom (procurement), David (infra) — please correct if I missed anyone.
- Success criteria: cost target met in production for 30 days or rollback; infra SLA of 99.9% for inference endpoints; agreed rollout plan documented.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Pilot (2–4 weeks) — Redwood hosted dedicated capacity; integration + observability. Deliverable: pilot report with latency/cost baseline. Target start: 2026-03-29.
2) PoC optimizations (2 weeks) — batching + KV caching config, model quantization recommendation. Deliverable: performance delta report. Target: 2026-04-12.
3) Production rollout & SLA (2–3 weeks) — Dedicated pool & rollout policy; 2-week canary. Target: 2026-04-26.
4) Post-rollout validation (30 days) — cost & quality monitoring, rollback criteria. Target completion: 2026-05-24.

Next steps:
- Please confirm stakeholders and internal procurement timeline (cc Tom if appropriate).
- If these milestones look reasonable I can update the MAP template with exact owners and add HubSpot deal milestones (link below).

I've attached a lightweight MAP template (Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx) and linked the HubSpot deal. If you want, Mateo is available to run a short technical onboarding/architecture review next Tuesday (3/24).

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38KB)

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Recap & MAP draft (next steps)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligns with our notes from the call. A few clarifications: 

- Procurement timeline: Tom (cc) is aiming for vendor selection and initial P.O. by end of April; procurement approval meetings are scheduled the week of 4/20.
- Stakeholders: please add David Nguyen (our infra lead) and Priya Sinha (security/compliance) to the MAP; I'll intro once we have the draft owners.
- Pilot scope: can we confirm that the pilot will include both our chat and batch-rerank routes? We want to validate cost across both patterns.

On targets: the latency and cost objectives look reasonable. Agree on a 2–4 week pilot window.

Next: Tom — can you confirm procurement constraints (PO timing / contract review) so Marissa can align MAP dates?

Appreciate it,
Alice
Senior PM, Acme Corp
alice.johnson@acme.com

Alice / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Alice's notes I've updated the attached MAP with the following:

- Added scope to include chat + batch-rerank routes.
- Added owners: Marissa (Commercial owner), Mateo (Technical owner), Tom (Procurement owner).
- Added stakeholders to intro: David Nguyen (infra) and Priya Sinha (security) — Alice will intro.
- Adjusted dates to reflect procurement window: Pilot start remains 2026-03-29; production rollout moved to 2026-04-28 to accommodate procurement review week of 4/20.

Action items:
- Alice: please intro David/ Priya and confirm PO timing.
- Tom: confirm if 4/28+ rollout is acceptable for procurement (esp. contract review lead time).
- Mateo / Dev: I’ve listed a tentative tech onboarding session on 2026-03-24. Mateo will confirm availability.

I've uploaded the updated MAP to the HubSpot deal and attached a local copy (Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx). Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890

If everyone is aligned I propose we lock the MAP by EOD Friday 3/20 so procurement and infra have time to schedule reviews.

Best,
